integrity: A direct mathematical proof and standard-library exhaustive checker are provided; no independent mathematical audit or publication-priority certification has been obtained.
scientific_limitations: Only simple labelled crown graphs of order 2n with n>=3; ordinary defensive alliances, not strong or dominating global alliances. Finite checks do not establish general validity. General minimal-alliance enumeration literature from 2023 and 2026 remains a substantive full-text priority uncertainty.
title: Globally and locally minimal defensive alliances of crown graphs
